text:
alex: Hey team — PR #52099 is ready for review. It wires the fallback routing + canary cutover for model cache. Need runtime, platform, infra, and security eyes before I merge Tue 10:00 PT canary window. Can people volunteer for ownership? @priya @sam @morgan @lee :wave
priya: I can take platform and the canary rollout plan. Will check the console dashboards and rollout config. ETA EOD today.
sam: I can do runtime perf + KV cache checks tomorrow morning. Quick q: does this change the prefix-caching header?
alex: Good q — small header tweak: we add `X-Cache-Prefetch: true` for warmup. Snippet:```yaml
orchestration:
  fallback: true
  prefetch_header: "X-Cache-Prefetch"
  canary:
    percent: 5
    duration_minutes: 30
```
morgan: I can own infra compatibility. There is a network ACL tweak required for the canary worker to reach the metrics collector on 10.3.4.12:9000. I'll drop a config patch in the PR. Also pls ensure the canary runs in the same AZ as the collector.
alex: thanks — noted. @morgan can you paste the ACL diff when ready?
morgan: yup, will add. small note: rolling only the canary group to avoid blast radius.
sec-bot: Automated security scan: no critical findings. 1 medium: etcd port 2379 reachable from canary subnet. Recommend limiting to internal cluster CIDR. Link: https://internal.redwood/sec/scan/52099
lee: Thx @sec-bot. I can do the security review — will verify the etcd exposure and request an ACL change if needed. If infra locks down 2379 to cluster CIDR I'll LGTM. Also want a 2-line threat model in the PR description (data plane creds not exposed, no cross-customer access).
alex: will add the threat model note now and push a small ACL change suggested by @morgan.
priya: once infra + security sign off I can schedule the canary for Tue 10:00 PT. Ping me when both are green and I'll cut the rollout.
sam: runtime notes: will run perf test at 08:00 PT Tue, will report token latency and KV hit rate.
morgan: ACL diff pushed to PR, see comment.
lee: Reviewed ACL + threat model; infra change looks good. Security conditionally approved, pending canary logs showing no external etcd access during the window.
alex: awesome — thanks everyone. Plan: merge Tue 09:45 PT, canary 10:00 PT at 5% for 30m, monitoring + rollback playbook ready. @priya to run rollout. 
priya: got it — will monitor and post update in #incidents if anything abnormal. :white_check_mark:
alex: great — tagging for visibility @oncall :thumbsup
